longAnimationFrameCapture.definition: LoAF entries represent UI-thread sequences over 50 ms; their duration excludes presentation. Entries are associated with measured rAF windows by timestamp overlap, so attribution to an arm is approximate.

frameMeasurement: rAF callback interval from the callback before a synchronous host update to the next callback. Intervals above 1.5x the same-page idle median are flagged; estimated missed slots use round(interval / idleMedian) - 1. This is a main-thread frame-cadence proxy, not proof of compositor/display presentation.
validity: Each arm receives the same 8 alternating queryA/queryB changes. One update runs between adjacent animation-frame callbacks, allowing cadence observation around each synchronous render/commit and browser rendering opportunity. Warmups and arm order are balanced; intermediate DOM digests are compared. Before each sequence, the harness asserts and records that only the requested arm's list is connected to the document; the other panels retain equal-size empty placeholders. Inactive DOM trees remain retained in memory. Mount is outside the timed sequence. The Long Animation Frames observer runs during the study; each >50 ms entry is associated with an update window by timestamp overlap, an approximate attribution that may include neighboring work. Synthetic deterministic rows and one Chrome/device limit generalization.
